$schema_note: Reusable evaluation shapes required by this clause set, expressed without reference to the regulation, its jurisdiction or its subject matter. `used_by` is the only field naming clauses.
honesty_note: Where two clauses need genuinely different shapes, that is two primitives. field_present and all_present are not merged, because a conjunction failing on one member must not report as one absent field. any_present and none_of_class_present are not merged, because their operands differ. member_of_register and member_of_enumeration are not merged, because one moves with an institution and the other with the rule text.

integrity.domain_term_check_note: Word-boundary matched. An earlier run flagged `distinct_members_at_least` because the substring `card` occurs inside `cardinality`, which is the standard mathematical term and not a domain word. Recorded because a substring check on a term list is exactly the shape that produces a false finding.
integrity.coverage_check: WITHDRAWN AND REPLACED. This object used to carry `clauses_no_primitive_serves`, computed here by asking whether each clause id appeared in some primitive's `used_by` list below. It reported [] while `34-2010/3.6/p5/expediente-copy` was declared under `elapsed_within` and `conditional_requirement` and invoked by neither, so every case table printed 18 rows against a 19 clause register and nothing said so. A `used_by` list is an author's statement of intent: written by hand, never executed, and nothing makes it true. Coverage is now checked by `check-coverage.mjs`, which compares the register against the ids a LIVE EVALUATOR RUN emits, by set equality, reporting missing and extra separately. Shown to fail by deleting the expediente clause from the evaluator: the new check reports MISSING and exits 1, the old one still passed.
integrity.used_by_is_documentation: `used_by` below stays, and is documentation only. It records which primitive an author INTENDED to serve a clause. It is not evidence that anything calls it and must never again be used as a coverage test.
integrity.used_by_correction_2026_08_21: `field_present` no longer names 34-2010/3.6/a/evidence or 34-2010/3.6/a/verification-method. It was wrong: both clauses read a BOOLEAN ASSERTION about the world (`evidence_of_factors_present`, `verification_method_stated`), not a container whose fill state is the question, and clauses.json gives their basis as `Presence of an evidence item`. Applying field_present to them returns `present` for a recorded `false`, which rules a dictamen stating no evidence as conforming and flips 3.6/p4/floor to floor_met and 3.6/p7/firmeza to not_attached. The inline ternary at those two call sites is CORRECT and was left alone; this documentation-only field was the half that was wrong. Measured in ../_primitives/INVENTORY-AUDIT.md.

primitives.name: elapsed_within
primitives.description: Whether an end event fell within a limit of a start event, measured in a named calendar unit. Returns a third value when the end event did not occur, because that is not the same as occurring late.

primitives.name: select_parameter_by_predicate
primitives.description: Chooses which parameter a downstream rule applies, based on a fact about the case rather than about the rule. Distinct from a conditional obligation: the obligation holds either way, only its parameter changes.

primitives.name: field_present
primitives.description: Whether a value was supplied. Carries no opinion about whether the value is adequate.

primitives.name: all_present
primitives.description: Whether every member of a required conjunction was supplied. Separate from field_present because a conjunction failing on one member must not report as a single absent field.

primitives.name: any_present
primitives.description: Whether at least one of a set of mutually acceptable alternatives was supplied. The alternatives are equivalent for the rule's purpose; which one was supplied does not change the result.

primitives.name: conditional_requirement
primitives.description: Applies a requirement only where a separate precondition holds. Returns a third value when the precondition fails, so that not applicable is distinguishable from satisfied. Conflating the two is the failure this shape exists to prevent.

primitives.name: member_of_register
primitives.description: Whether an identifier appears in an authority set maintained by the obligated party. The register's contents are an institutional fact, not part of the rule.

primitives.name: distinct_members_at_least
primitives.description: Whether a collection contains at least N members that are mutually independent under a supplied relation. The relation is a parameter because independence is a property of the pair, not of any member, and a naive cardinality count over a set answers a different question.

primitives.name: member_of_enumeration
primitives.description: Whether a value is drawn from a closed set the rule declares. Distinct from member_of_register: the enumeration is part of the rule text and moves only when the rule does.

primitives.name: none_of_class_present
primitives.description: Whether a collection is free of members of a prohibited class. A prohibition, not a requirement, and the inverse of any_present rather than its negation, because the operands are different sets.

primitives.name: open_set_floor
primitives.description: Whether every enumerated minimum was met, WITHOUT concluding that the obligation is satisfied. The rule text declares its list a minimum, so a caller that reads floor_met as conformance has drawn a conclusion the rule declines to license.

primitives.name: held_judgment
primitives.description: Carries an assessment made by a person, unchanged. Present so that a qualitative standard occupies a slot in the evaluation rather than being silently skipped or silently defaulted. It computes nothing.

primitives.name: conjunction_over_results
primitives.description: Composes several rule results into one, with an explicit policy for what an undetermined input makes of the whole. The policy is a parameter because a composition that silently treats undetermined as pass and one that treats it as fail are different rules.
